title: Guan Lu Reads the Future; Five Officers Try to Burn the Capital
summary: The diviner Guan Lu tells Cao Cao's fortune with unpleasant accuracy and declines all reward. Five loyalist officers, taking his reading as a signal, raise a fire in Xuchang and try to kill Cao Cao during it.

It fails. Cao Cao assembles the entire court and orders those who helped put the fire out to stand on one side and those who stayed indoors on the other; then he executes everyone on the first side, on the grounds that they were carrying weapons.
history: The plot is historical. The trick with the two sides is the novel's, and it is the single most chilling thing Cao Cao does in the book.

pins.note: Reads the future accurately, and declines payment.
